source.authorityName: School examination paper (school not named); obtained from icseboard.org, originally from icseonline.com
source.notes: ICSE Class VIII school final (annual) examination paper (school not named). Header prints 'Final Examination - 2017-2018', 'PHYSICS', 'Std. : VIII', 'Time : 2 hrs. + 15 min.', 'F. M. : 80'; examYear 2018 is the later year of the printed session (also the year in the file name). durationMinutes 135 = 2 h + 15 min as printed. The PDF has no text layer (watermark only); text was OCRed with RapidOCR and corrected against the page images. Section A (40 Marks, Q1-Q4) is compulsory; each question prints '(2x5=10)', i.e. 2 marks for each of its five sub-parts. Section B (40 Marks) says 'Attempt any four questions' and prints Q5-Q9 (10 marks each), so the pack totals 90. Magnetism items are mapped to the electricity chapter and Newton's-laws/gravity items to force-and-pressure as the nearest listed chapters. No answer key is printed; no official answers exist.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
